name: io.github.klingai-dev/kling-ai
title: Kling AI Global Plugin
description: Official Kling AI Global Remote MCP Plugin. OAuth sign-in enables image creation and editing, video generation, motion control, reusable Elements, task tracking, and credit lookup. Generation consumes Global account credits; available models and options depend on live MCP tools.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: OAuth; sign in to your Kling AI Global account.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.usage: Generation consumes credits from the connected regional Kling AI account. Available models and costs depend on that account. This listing does not grant free generation or transfer credits between regions.
